AUTHOR: Wibowo
TITLE: Optimization of Tiny YOLOv7 Lightweight Model Through Network Structure Re-parameterization for Coral Reef Fish Identification
VENUE: 2024 International Conference on ICT for Smart Society (ICISS)
SPECIES: Ostracion cubicum, Dascyllus trimaculatus, Zebrasoma flavescens, butterflyfish
DATA: DOV coral reef fish survey videos (own/partner), frames annotated in Roboflow
D_EV: Sec. III-A: 'The preprocessing process expands the image dataset to 1500 images which are divided into 1199 images for training (80%), 199 images for validation (13%) and 102 images for testing (7%).'
R_EV: Sec. III-A: 'The number of images extracted from DOV was 994' (single dataset; test split of same images)
E_EV: Table III reports only precision, recall, mAP, F1: 'achieved an F1 score of 86.64 and a mean average precision (mAP) of 90.50%'
ARCH: Tiny YOLOv7 re-parameterized with CBL/CBM blocks; deployed on Jetson Nano with OAK-D stereo camera
METR: Precision, recall, mAP, F1, parameters, GFLOPs, FPS on device
NOTE: Frames extracted from DOV videos and split by image after histogram-equalization 'expansion' to 1500 images (augmented copies likely spread across splits; leakage not discussed). Stereo length/biomass functionality described but not evaluated. Survey location not stated.
